verdict.rationale: Bento's docs show first-party LLM call tracing. It captures every span over OpenTelemetry with a span tree view, offers SDK-level capture of every LLM call, auto-instruments Google ADK model and tool calls, and provides `bento.track_ai` to wrap any LLM call manually. Cost-per-run analytics also suggest it records token usage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that captured spans include prompt inputs, outputs, latency and token counts as fields, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
